title: Motor communication error
fullDescription:
Error E1 on Unagi scooters indicates the controller does not detect a proper signal from the front or rear motor. Check the motor connector at the stem base.

Unagi dual-motor models may show E1 when only one motor is faulty.

fixSteps.title: Reseat motor connector
fixSteps.instruction: Access deck and reseat motor plug.

fixSteps.title: Service center
fixSteps.instruction: If fault persists, have motor tested.

faq.q: Can I ride with one motor?
faq.a: Yes at reduced performance; fix soon.

title: Throttle input error
shortDescription: Throttle reads abnormal value at rest.
fullDescription: Error E2 means the throttle is returning a signal when released. Typically a water-ingress problem or worn Hall sensor.

fixSteps.title: Dry and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Dry throttle connector, apply dielectric grease.

faq.a: Not recommended; leads to E2 over time.

title: Brake signal error
shortDescription: Brake lever reads engaged when released.
fullDescription: E3 indicates the brake lever or regenerative brake sensor is constantly pressed. Cutoff prevents riding. Clean lever pivot or replace the microswitch.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate pivot
fixSteps.instruction: Apply light lubricant on lever pivot.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch
fixSteps.instruction: If switch is stuck, replace it.

faq.a: Cold grease can stiffen the lever.

title: Battery undervoltage
shortDescription: Battery voltage is too low to operate.
fullDescription: Error E4 is raised when voltage is under threshold. Charge fully. If charging does not recover the battery, it may be damaged.
whenToCallPro: If scooter cannot take a charge.

faq.a: Don't let battery sit empty for weeks.

title: Battery overvoltage
fullDescription: Error E5 indicates overvoltage. Almost always triggered by non-OEM chargers. Use the Unagi charger.

faq.q: Can the wrong charger hurt the battery?

title: Controller overheat
fullDescription: E6 appears when the main controller overheats from sustained hill climbing or hot weather.
whenToCallPro: If it occurs under light load.

title: Motor overheat
fullDescription: E7 indicates motor overheat. Pause riding; the motor will cool in 15-20 minutes.
whenToCallPro: If it repeats at light load.

title: Dashboard communication error
fullDescription: E8 indicates a broken link between dashboard and controller. Usually the stem cable.

faq.a: Repeated folding can fatigue the cable.

title: Battery communication error
fullDescription: E9 shows when communication to the battery BMS fails. Inspect data cable and connector under the deck.

title: Firmware / system error
fullDescription: E10 is a catch-all for firmware or system-level faults. Restart the scooter. If persistent, contact Unagi support for firmware update or RMA.

fixSteps.title: Contact support
fixSteps.instruction: Open ticket with Unagi support for further steps.
